name: Surviving High School
source:
Surviving High School is a choice-based visual novel with elements of Choose your Own Adventure and interactive fiction. It follows Centerscore High, a typical high school with very recognizable cliques of students. Players control several unique Centerscore students throughout the game. They are given scenarios where they must choose between two or more decisions that may negatively or positively affect the outcome of each story. Stories are presented through episodes, which are grouped within volumes or sets. Volumes typically contain around eight episodes. 

Prior to the September 2012 update, the game came with two free playable stories: "The Football Star" and "The New Girl". While both allow the customization of the player character's name, only the former allows the changing of appearance. All further content must be purchased via the in-game store "More Episodes" or downloaded in the Now Airing feature.

On April 30, 2014, it was announced during one of the episodes that the game would be ending soon. The final episode was released in July 2014.

[From Wikipedia]
translation:
《高中求生》是一款以選擇為核心的視覺小說，包含「選擇你的冒險」與互動小說元素。故事發生在中心高中，這是一所擁有各種鮮明學生小團體的普通高中。玩家將在整個遊戲中操控數名獨特的中心高中學生。他們會遇到必須在兩個或更多選項中做出選擇的情境，而選擇可能對每個故事的結果產生正面或負面影響。故事以分集形式呈現，各集歸入不同卷或套裝；每卷通常包含約八集。

2012年9月更新前，遊戲包含兩個可免費遊玩的故事：「足球明星」和「轉學女生」。兩者都允許自訂玩家角色姓名，但只有前者允許更改外觀。之後的所有內容都必須透過遊戲內商店「更多劇集」購買，或在「正在播出」功能中下載。

2014年4月30日，遊戲在某一集播出時宣布即將結束。最終集於2014年7月推出。

[來源：維基百科]
